recipes.name: Macaroni Salad with Lentil Quesadillas
instructions: Cook the lentils in a saucepan according to the package instruction.
In a large pot, cook the macaroni according to the package instructions. In the last 2 minutes of cooking, add the green peas.
When the pasta is al dente, drain and transfer to a large bowl.
To the same bowl, add the carrot, yogurt, onion, burrito seasoning, bouillon, and pepper. Mix.
To make the quesadillas, check to ensure the lentils are fully cooked. When they are soft through into the centre, drain well.
Transfer the drained lentils to a large bowl, along with the crushed tomato, and burrito spice. Use a fork or potato masher to mash until roughly puréed.
Spread the lentil mixture over each half of the tortilla wraps. Fold in half.

Heat half of the oil in a large pan over medium heat. Place two of the quesadillas in the pan and cook for 1 to 2 minutes on each side, or until golden. Transfer to a plate and repeat with the remaining quesadillas.
To make the quick salsa, add the tomatoes, onion, garlic, salt, and pepper to a bowl. Mix.
Cut the quesadillas into triangles and serve with the salsa and macaroni salad. Enjoy!

page_recipe_notes: Notes † Our large tortillas measure about 10 inches (25 cm) in diameter.
Storage Store the macaroni salad and quesadillas separately in airtight container s in the fridge for up to 3 days.
